exposure: time interval between decision to delivery
time taken from referring institution to managing institution
fetal heart beat abnormality (fetal bradycardia, fetal tachycardia)
cohort: The study included 875 mothers who gave birth with emergency cesarean section in specialized hospitals.
finding: The prevalence of meconium-stained amniotic fluid was 31.4%, and it was associated with factors such as gravidity, eclampsia, obstructed labor, cephalopelvic disproportion, fetal heart rate abnormalities, duration of labor, and inter-institutional transfer times.
